summary: The first birthday of #web30 was done in partnership with #HigherEd. I want the same for #web31, community has always been the curriculum. Let's model and teach basic web literacy and anchor the cornerstone of the local web in our schools, libraries and local news.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: The first birthday of #web30 was done in partnership with #HigherEd. I want the same for #web31, community has always been the curriculum. Let's model and teach basic web literacy and anchor the cornerstone of the local web in our schools, libraries and local news.
